_comment: This file holds what JJ Flexible says and shows, for the logging area. Logging and cluster. EDITING: change the text on the right of the colon; never change the key on the left, and never change anything inside curly braces such as {radio} - those are filled in at run time with the actual radio name, frequency and so on. A key whose text is missing is spoken as the key itself, so if you hear something like connect.radio_found read out literally, that key needs text. YOUR OWN COPY: put a file of this same name in the lexicon folder beside your settings and it layers on top of this one, key by key - you only need the keys you want to change, and everything else keeps working. If your file has a typo in it, it is ignored and this one is used, so a mistake can never stop the program. LADDERS: a key may hold three tiers instead of one string - critical, terse and chatty - which is how one message gets shorter as you turn verbosity down. This partition is empty; the extraction tracks fill it. See docs/planning/active/string-store-contract.md.
logging.problem.announcement: {what}. Press Control J then Control R for details.
logging.problems.lead_truncated: Newest first. The oldest entries have been dropped from this list to keep it manageable, but the diagnostic log still has them.
logging.problems.lead: Newest first. Each line gives the time, what failed, and what it means.
logging.problems.no_log: No diagnostic log is running, so this list is all there is about these problems. You can turn a log on in Settings, Diagnostics, and it will record what happens from then on.
logging.problems.log_running: The diagnostic log recorded far more about each of these than this list shows. It stays on this computer. Nothing is sent anywhere.
logging.problems.open_failed: The problems list could not be opened.
logging.problems.save_failed: The diagnostic log could not be copied. It is still in the settings folder.
logging.problems.copy_failed: The problems could not be copied to the clipboard.
logging.log_file.must_be_defined: A log file must be defined.
logging.log_entry.bad_freq_suffix: must be of the form mhz.khz.hz, mhz.khz, or khz.
logging.trace.prune_none: No trace archives older than {days} days to remove.
logging.trace.prune_one: Removed {pruned} trace archive entry older than {days} days.
logging.trace.prune_many: Removed {pruned} trace archive entries older than {days} days.
logging.capture.already_running: Detailed capture is already running, started {started}.
logging.capture.start_failed: The detailed capture could not be started.
logging.capture.start_failed_what: The detailed capture could not be started
logging.capture.start_failed_detail: JJ Flex could not open a new log file for the capture. The ordinary diagnostic log is still running, so there is still a record of what happens next.
logging.capture.started: Detailed capture started. Reproduce the problem, then stop the capture from this button or the Diagnostics tab.
logging.capture.save_problem: The capture was stopped, but saving it ran into a problem.
logging.debug_bundle.must_specify_file: You must specify a debug file.
logging.debug_bundle.gather_failed: The debug archive could not be completed.{newline}{newline}This usually means there wasn't room for it, or a file in the settings{newline}folder was too large to include. Nothing was lost — your settings and{newline}traces are untouched. Try again with a different destination, or send{newline}the most recent trace from the Trace Archive instead.
logging.debug_bundle.gather_failed_speec: The debug archive could not be completed. Nothing was lost.
logging.debug_bundle.report_failure_what: The problem report could not be built
logging.debug_bundle.report_failure_deta: Nothing was lost — your settings and diagnostic logs are untouched. The diagnostic log on its own still carries most of what the developer needs.
logging.install_check.differences_one: Install verification found {count} difference — see install-verification.txt.
logging.install_check.differences_many: Install verification found {count} differences — see install-verification.txt.
logging.install_check.manifest_unreadabl: Install could not be checked — the shipped manifest was unreadable. See install-verification.txt.
logging.install_check.skipped: Install check skipped — no shipped manifest to compare against.
